subject: Key escrow transfer & HSM audit collection - RFP evidence request
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <m.lopez@novaguard.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novaguard.com
Date: Sun, 05 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Key escrow transfer & HSM audit collection - RFP evidence request

Irene,

Thanks for taking this RFP. As part of our security due diligence for the upcoming procurement window we need a packaged set of evidence that demonstrates Redwood's controls around HSM-backed key custody, BYOK import handling, and historical key rotation. Our reviewers have asked for the following items (we'll need them by COB 2027-09-14):

- HSM audit log extracts showing import/activation/zeroization events (time-limited redacted snippets are fine)
- BYOK import records and corresponding KMIP/PKCS#11 events with timestamps
- Key rotation timeline and proof for any keys used to encrypt customer data in the last 18 months
- TLS endpoint cert chain and cipher negotiation summary for model serving endpoints
- A notarized/DocuSign-ready attestation template for key escrow transfer procedures (we require a signed doc for procurement)
- A manifest that lists included files and describes any redactions

Prefer a single ZIP with the manifest and a short readme describing redaction rules. If you can provide an ETA for a preliminary package and a redacted sample of the HSM log, that would be very helpful — our security team wants to vet the log formatting before ingestion.

Let me know if you need a standard format or if we should accept CSV/JSON extracts. We may follow up with a quick 30-minute deep-dive call.

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
Sr. Security Program Manager
NovaGuard
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <m.lopez@novaguard.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 05 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Key escrow transfer & HSM audit collection - RFP evidence request

Marta —

Appreciate the clarity. We can absolutely assemble a single ZIP as you describe. Proposed plan:

1) I will own the evidence manifest and readme (will include redaction rules and hash mapping).
2) Kar (karthik) will produce redacted HSM audit log excerpts and BYOK import records.
3) Mina will prepare the attestation template and route it through DocuSign.
4) Lauren will validate the TLS endpoint certificate bundle and provide the cipher list.

ETA: preliminary package (manifest + redacted sample log) by 2027-09-09 EOD, full package by 2027-09-12. If procurement needs the notarized attestation sooner we can prioritize.

Format note: we will provide CSV extracts for the audit snippets and a small JSON index that maps hashed key IDs to the redacted entries (no raw key material). The manifest will include SHA256 checksums for each file.

Attachments: initial_evidence_manifest.txt (stub) — includes outline of files we plan to include.

If that cadence works, please confirm and we can schedule the 30-minute call; we recommend a technical call prior to delivery so we can explain redaction and indexing.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Security Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Kar Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marta Lopez <m.lopez@novaguard.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Key escrow transfer & HSM audit collection - RFP evidence request

On Sep 5, 2027, at 11:05 AM, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> ETA: preliminary package (manifest + redacted sample log) by 2027-09-09 EOD, full package by 2027-09-12.

Quick technical note from the runtime/infra side:

- HSM audit exports will be FIPS-validated audit snippets (we'll include import, activation, and zeroization events). We'll redact tenant identifiers to a one-way hash and include the transformation algorithm in the manifest.
- BYOK import records come from our KMIP proxy; we'll include the KMIP request/response IDs and timestamps (no private key material).
- For rotation proof: we can provide signed rotation events stored in the audit ledger (each entry has a signature we can show and a key version map).
- TLS: we'll include the cert chain for public inference endpoints and a brief table of observed cipher suites across the last 90 days.

Attachment: hsm_export_snippets.zip (contains redacted CSV + JSON index stub). I will mark the ZIP as encrypted in transit (we'll share the passphrase over a separate channel).

If you need a specific CSV schema, say so; otherwise we'll use the schema documented in the manifest.

—Kar
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <m.lopez@novaguard.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Sep 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Key escrow transfer & HSM audit collection - RFP evidence request

Irene, Marta —

We've drafted an attestation template that covers: custody transfer steps, escrow holder responsibilities, proof of secure transport, and acceptance criteria. For procurement we can produce a DocuSign envelope that includes the attestation plus an Appendix A listing the file inventory and checksums.

We'll include a notarized option if required by contract; note that adds ~3–5 business days for notary scheduling.

Attachment: attestation-template.docx
Related link: https://docusign.com/xyz/NG-Attestation-2027

Mina
Head of Compliance & Privacy, Redwood Inference
From: Marta Lopez <m.lopez@novaguard.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novaguard.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Key escrow transfer & HSM audit collection - RFP evidence request

Thanks — that sounds like a good plan.

We can take the preliminary package on 2027-09-09 and will review the redacted HSM log sample. Let's schedule the 30-minute technical call on 2027-09-08 at 13:00 UTC (10:00 ET) to walk through the manifest and hashing approach. Please send a calendar invite.

Also, please ensure the HSM sample includes at least two import events, one rotation event, and one zeroization event so our reviewers can validate the format.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Marta
